name: Elijah Modnar
source:
A former colleague of Jamie and Gillian in the past, he has resurfaced as the originator of the Snatcher menace. Although quite old now, he has a brilliant mind, which he uses to his full advantage to see his plan to it's fullest potential.

[From [url=http://www.justinaaron.com/thekremlin/modnar.html]The Kremlin[/url]]
